_comment: CORS policy for the Cloud Storage bucket that serves the factory library. `{{PROJECT_ID}}` is substituted with the target project by scripts/starter-library/upload.mjs, so this file stays correct for any Firebase project. Apply it with `bun run library:upload -- --configure-bucket` (or `gcloud storage buckets update gs://BUCKET --cors-file=` once the placeholders are replaced). Reads only: nothing writes to this bucket from a browser (see storage.rules).
